hook.name: InkHook
hook.description: Manages the INK/IMD Uniswap v4 pool with a governance gate that blocks all swaps until an external vault contract signals `released()`, then levies a configurable fee (`feeBps` bps) on every swap via afterSwapReturnsDelta, waived for holders of an agent portrait NFT. Collected fees are distributed to a treasury (IMD) and a liquidity contract (INK). Ownerless and immutable.
